This '''[[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]]''' lived on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], in the city of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]]. As the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] was strolling around in the city, this Aqualish was seen spitting into a bucket.<ref name="MIA" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to [[StarWars.com]] "Missing in Action" Trivia Gallery, this Aqualish was designed to resemble the [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] [[Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|action figure]] of [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]], nicknamed "Walrus Man", first introduced in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ep guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep512|text="Missing in Action" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 1}}</ref>
